cohort: Neonates below 28 days of age suspected to have late onset sepsis at a tertiary care center from central India between January 2019 and December 2021.
finding: The prevalence of gram-negative late onset sepsis was 4.8%, and low birth weight and prematurity were associated with poor outcomes (death).
followup_time: Up to 28 days of age (late onset sepsis)
birth_weight: Low birth weight associated with poor outcome (exact values not specified)
